description: The chart illustrates the performance of various Large Language Models on two benchmarks, MATH-500 and AIME24, separated into two main dashed-line panels containing three sub-charts each, labeled (a) through (f). A legend at the top maps visual properties to specific models and methods: solid bars represent "CoT" and diagonally striped bars represent "TTS". Colors correspond to specific models, including blue (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct), purple (GPT-4o), green (Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct), pink (o1-mini), brown (o1-preview), tan (DeepSeek-R1), orange (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B), gray (o1), and a red striped pattern. The horizontal axes across all sub-charts display categorical labels denoting model sizes (e.g., 3B, 1.5B, 7B, 405B, 671B) or "unk" for unknown. The vertical axes represent numerical scores on a linear scale. For the MATH-500 sub-charts (a, b, c), the vertical axes range from 65 to 100 with tick intervals of 5. For the AIME24 sub-charts (d, e, f), the vertical axes range from 0 to 90 with tick intervals of 10. Each bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical value annotated at the top and an inset square icon representing the model's developer (Meta, OpenAI, or DeepSeek). Within each of the six sub-charts, the three bars are sorted in descending order of their value. In the MATH-500 panel, sub-chart (a) contains a blue striped bar (78.2), a purple solid bar (74.6), and a green solid bar (71.4); sub-chart (b) contains a red striped bar (91.6), a pink solid bar (90.0), and a brown solid bar (85.5); and sub-chart (c) contains a tan solid bar (97.3, the tallest in this panel), an orange striped bar (95.2), and a gray solid bar (94.8). In the AIME24 panel, sub-chart (d) contains a blue striped bar (30.0), a green solid bar (23.3), and a purple solid bar (9.3, the shortest overall); sub-chart (e) contains a pink solid bar (63.6), a red striped bar (63.3), and a brown solid bar (44.6); and sub-chart (f) contains an orange striped bar (83.3, the tallest in this panel), a tan solid bar (79.8), and a gray solid bar (79.2).
